I phoned the practice, that evening to confirm that I would be on a plane to Australia. The taxi was picking me up at 3.30am for the airport. All of this was completely unnecessary, had the practice doctor seen me, \u0026 given me a prescription. The receptionist (Lesley) was very sympathetic, and did her very best to resolve this nightmare of a situation. Everyone knows that you can go online at 8 AM to fill out a health form and submit it to the doctor for an appointment. Those with experience also know that after 9 AM, appointments are basically unavailable.

This morning at 8 AM, I submitted the form, and around 10:30 AM, I received a message stating that a doctor would call me sometime between 8 AM and 6 PM today. However, by 4 PM, I still hadn’t received any call. I contacted the clinic, and the staff told me they would reach out to the doctor for a response.

By 5 PM, I still hadn’t heard anything, so I went to the clinic in person. The receptionist told me that I would only receive a call tomorrow, which I found completely unreasonable since I hadn’t been notified of any changes. She explained that the "call tomorrow" message hadn’t been sent yet, and if I needed urgent care, I should go to the emergency clinic.

I also asked her to contact the doctor on my behalf and relay my request for a call as soon as possible, but she firmly refused. I am extremely frustrated with this entire appointment system. Having to be online at 8 AM just to secure an appointment is already frustrating enough, but as a patient, waiting an entire day without any update is unacceptable. I honestly don’t understand the role of the receptionist—she seems more like an automated announcement system, refusing to accommodate even the most basic patient requests.

I would like say the form giving them a glimmer of hope, but in fact of forcing everyone into a stressful race to fill out the form first, while seeing a doctor or receiving a call is not even My brother, a patient at Millgate with no capacity and residing in assisted living accommodation, was in need of urgent medical attention due to illness.

Despite the staff's early morning call for a home visit, there was no response throughout the day. The carer contacted Millgate again towards end of day, only to be informed that a GP would arrange a visit. Unfortunately, Millgate did not attend and instead passed the responsibility to the out-of-hours service, which also failed to provide assistance for over 12 hours.

In desperation, the out-of-hours service eventually decided to call for an ambulance. This prolonged and inefficient process led to over 30 hours of neglect for my brother, who simply required antibiotics for a fever. Millgate's failure to address the situation promptly resulted in the unnecessary involvement of outside resources, including the ambulance service.

This situation not only reflects a significant lapse in patient care but also highlights the inefficient allocation of resources. My brother's case could have been handled more effectively in the initial stages by Millgate, preventing the need for escalated measures.

I urge Millgate Medical Practice to conduct a thorough review of this incident and take necessary measures to ensure that such lapses in service do not occur in the future. Timely and responsive care is crucial, especially for vulnerable individuals like my brother.",null,[0,238]]]],[null,1708341289000000,1708341289000000,"2 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUjBjbloxTm1oblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUjBjbloxTm1oblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUjBjbloxTm1oblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUjBjbloxTm1oblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUjBjbloxTm1oblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUjBjbloxTm1oblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. The online appointment booking system is so stressful , I usually don’t sleep the night before I get that anxious as it really is the appointment bingo before they shut the online system down , sometimes it hasn’t even been open an hour and it is closed .
Getting to see an actual doctor would be equivalent to having a small win on the lotto .
I filled an online form in this morning as I have been unwell since before Christmas now and I actually pretty much begged for help on the form .
I was called and given an appointment for Thursday …. It’s Monday ! That’s another four days of feeling like my chest is going to just pack in .
I was actually quite taken a back and on asking why I have to wait so long I was told , this is what the doctor decided , if you’re not happy go to the walk in , our staff are ill too.
Whilst I appreciate medical professionals get sick too , I’m not entirely sure who decided leaving me until Thursday was ok .
The walk in centre is located at Tameside hospital , a fair trek away , especially when you feel ill and you’re disabled and struggle with mobility.
Frustrating to say the least that the doctors surgery is around the corner but the phrase ‘go to the walk in centre then ‘ is bandied about like it’s that easy or acceptable.
Going to A&E just shouldn’t be you’re only option when your doctors surgery has two sites and is where you live .
Early December I was sent an asthma check form via text . I filled it in which resulted in them saying I need a check , this was the 8th December , my appointment for said check is February , 2 months , 8 weeks wait .
Now I have had a chest infection since before Christmas and I can’t be seen .
I had a blood test recently , I was not contacted with the results , just a text saying I needed them redoing in one month , someone really should call you and say why , clearly they need redoing for a reason but , just that faceless text .
The faceless cold ideology surrounding the whole practice is a struggle . Everything is done via texts and online forms . You NEVER get to see who you want , which leads me to question why that option is on the online form - is there anyone in particular you would like to see …
There is no continuity of care , which is very much needed when long term chronic illnesses are involved .
I cannot fault the reception staff , I have never had a problem with them . Sheila in particular always goes above and beyond and is very good at her job and she is actually very lovely  mannered .
I do however question the doctor who decides who gets the appointments and who you see after you have filled the online form in , as 8/10 times I get there and I'm not seeing a doctor .
I do not recall ever having a problem with care for my daughter and IF I get to see a doctor i am always happy with their treatment but , I never see a doctor .",null,[0,163]]]],[null,1708342248000000,1708342248000000,"2 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUk9PWFF6UmxoM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUk9PWFF6UmxoM0VBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUk9PWFF6UmxoM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUk9PWFF6UmxoM0VBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUk9PWFF6UmxoM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15434642799398966497/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUk9PWFF6UmxoM0VBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review.
